rows.title: Vincent Van Gogh
notes: “Two tunes we started off with, RVG with Vincent Van Gogh”
Track 6 on RVG's 2017 debut album A Quality of Mercy (Our Golden Friend/Fat Possum), recorded live at Melbourne's The Tote.

rows.title: Guard Dog
notes: “a new song from her called Guard Dog”
New double single 'Guard Dog' / 'Move Dirt Around' (Dot Dash/Remote Control), released October 2026 — about a pit bull she fostered.

rows.title: Cool Down
notes: “something new from Sydney, I think, Small Ways with Cool Down”
Second single off Sydney two-piece smallways.'s debut EP, released April 2024.
